project: Wuxia Life P82 Medical Sage Bridge Design-First Contract
description: Design-first contract stage for medical_sage_healer (一代名医) bridge + entry. Prerequisite audit, scope contract, bridge-shape comparison, bridge contract, validation shape, closure report. Doc-only stage, no runtime implementation.

userStories.title: Audit medical route prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the medical_sage_healer route so P82 starts from the real gating surfaces and not from assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize medical_sage_healer origin compatibility, flags, gates, existing expressions, existing tests
Clarify what exists before bridge and what is missing
Inventory available medical events in medical.json and flag propagation chain
Inventory P27/P29 habit-led medical events vs sample-line spine integration
Output docs/test-reports/p82-medical-sage-prerequisite-audit.md
No runtime behavior changes in this story
userStories.notes: Foundational audit; must complete before bridge-shape comparison.

userStories.title: Lock P82 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P82 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Clarify P82 does only gap audit, direction comparison, bridge contract, proof shape
Define allowed layers: docs, contract, targeted proof planning
Define prohibited items: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave
Define boundary with P83 (playable bridge)
Output docs/test-reports/p82-medical-sage-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope guardrails for the design-first stage.

userStories.title: Compare candidate bridge shapes
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded bridge-shape options for the medical_sage_healer route so P82 chooses the smallest viable entry path before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare at least 2 bridge shape directions (e.g. habit-led study-healer bridge vs social-momentum healer bridge)
State recommended direction and abandoned direction clearly
Recommendation must follow quality-first and small-step principles
Consider consistency with renown bridge methodology
Conclusion written into comparison document
userStories.notes: Key decision point for bridge shape.

userStories.title: Define medical sage bridge contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit bridge contract so P83 knows exactly what flags, gates, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define bridge checkpoint, required flags, corresponding gate acceptance
Define at least 2 bridge-specific player-facing signals
Clarify how medical bridge differs from generic path
Define entry differentiation shape (at least 2 entry variants)
Clarify衔接 with medical_sage_healer achievement unlock conditions
Contract written into PRD or appendix
userStories.notes: Core deliverable: bridge + entry contract for P83 implementation.

userStories.title: Define P83 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P83 validation shape fixed in advance so playable bridge work is judged against explicit proof and regression expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Clarify which chain nodes targeted proof must demonstrate
Clarify which assertions regression tests must cover at minimum
Clarify what evidence counts as bridge closed
Clarify that full lifetime exhaust is not required
Clarify boundary with P33 medical short-chain validation

userStories.title: Produce P82 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the medical sage route's design-first contract and hands off a bounded implementation target to P83.
acceptanceCriteria: Output docs/test-reports/p82-medical-sage-bridge-design-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, bridge-shape comparison, bridge contract, validation shape
Clarify boundary with P83
List deferred larger medical-expansion items
Give route planning recommendations after entry differentiation (on-ramp / pressure / payoff etc.)
userStories.notes: Closure and handoff to P83 playable bridge.
